prompt: Use case: game-scene-background. Create ONLY a new original background plate for the maintenance/workshop area of our portrait sci-fi mobile game. Input image 1 is our original workshop: retain its identity as a working carrier maintenance bay, the broad wall, edge window, and believable floor perspective, but remove distracting tiny details and repeated hard floor grids. Input images 2 and 3 are scene layers exported from OUR PSDs: they are the authority for art direction: bright cool steel-blue and pale silver lighting, structural silhouette, convincing spatial depth, dark edge framing, atmospheric distance, subtle cyan light, and a softly rendered 2D game illustration. Retain readable medium-sized shapes and deliberate light-dark contrast; do not replace a detailed environment with an empty blurry blue wall. No generic overblurring. Frame an actual workplace with a few large, softened maintenance structures and a believable floor/wall junction. Keep the center and lower right quiet enough for separately rendered slots, text, and a small assistant; concentrate recognizable structures at the edges. Landscape 3:2 composition, with important shapes safe in the centered 1.42:1 crop. Eye-level view, no extreme perspective. Not photoreal, not cinematic dark, no thick fog. Do not bake in a character, robot, aircraft, weapons, UI, button, icon, text, numerals, watermark, border, sticker or logo. Do not draw a diagonal scanline pattern: the authentic PSD texture will be composited separately at runtime. Direction A: preserve the workshop's asymmetry. A single broad overhead maintenance gantry enters from the upper left; one simplified workbench/cabinet silhouette rests along the far-left wall. A broad structural wall frame defines the background and a large high window on the right admits a soft sky glow. Show the floor plane and only two or three broad perspective seams and muted reflections, not a lattice. Include subtle cyan status lights and one small warm accent. The right-middle area behind the assistant remains midtone, not blown-out white.
